analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. 금일 RSI 53.5로 중립 구간 횡보 지속. MACD 히스토그램 개선세는 긍정적이나, ADX 10.7로 추세 형성 미흡하여 방향성 부재. 5일 거래량비 1.22로 움직임에 힘 실리지 않음. 스윙 지지선 34,485원, 저항선 38,775원 구간 내 횡보 지속 전망.
analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive trading days. Today, RSI remains in the neutral zone at 53.5. While the MACD histogram shows improvement, the ADX at 10.7 indicates a lack of trend formation, resulting in directional absence. The 5-day volume ratio of 1.22 does not lend significant momentum to price movements. Sideways consolidation is expected within the swing support of 34,485 KRW and resistance of 38,775 KRW.
